question.en: Discuss the role of IFAD in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in the context of rural India.
question.hi: Discuss the role of IFAD in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in the context of rural India.

modelAnswer.en: IFAD plays a crucial role by providing financial support for smallholder farmers, promoting climate-resilient agriculture, and enhancing rural infrastructure. This directly contributes to SDG 1 (No Poverty) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) by improving food security and rural livelihoods.
